# Ganpati Events

> Jodhpur-based birthday decoration, photography and sound for birthdays and celebrations. Premium decoration packages from Rs.14,000 to Rs.25,000, bookable directly on WhatsApp. Serving Jodhpur city and areas within 20 km of Jodhpur.

Ganpati Events turns birthdays into royal celebrations with theme-based decor, planned setup and on-ground coordination. Customers compare five decoration packages on the site and book via WhatsApp — no forms, no login.

## Decoration packages (one-time price, setup included)

- Essential Collection — Rs.14,000 — a clean, festive setup for an intimate birthday; best for an intimate celebration. Uses 3 backdrops in Butterfly / Prince / Jungle themes.
- Elegant Collection — Rs.16,000 — more backdrop coverage, a dedicated table and brighter accents; best for a medium-size celebration. Most booked.
- Elite Collection — Rs.20,000 — a full 20–25 ft stage with personalised name and photo displays; best for a bigger stage setup.
- Luxury Collection — Rs.25,000 — six backdrops, a 30-foot stage, a Teddy Man (any character) and a bubble entry; best for a grand birthday.
- Signature Collection — Rs.25,000 — most-booked premium custom experience with five backdrops, a centre 3D wooden backdrop and a centrepiece frame.

## Add-on services (booked on top of any package)

- Photography & Cinematography — Option 1 Rs. 12,000, Option 2 Rs. 10,000, Option 3 Rs. 7,000 (candid photographers / cinematographers / reel shoot).
- Sound — Rs. 3,000 — 1 top jodi sound + mic with professional operator.

## How booking works

1. Choose your package.
2. Check date availability on WhatsApp.
3. Finalise theme and details (theme, colours, name, photos).
4. Advance payment confirms your date.
5. The team arrives before the event and completes the setup.

## Frequently asked questions

- Areas covered: Jodhpur city plus areas within 20 km of Jodhpur.
- Setup timing: the team arrives and sets up 5–6 hours before the event starts.
- Booking: tap a WhatsApp button, share package and date; the team confirms availability.
- Theme customisation: yes, custom themes, colours and requirements are available.
- Advance: amount depends on the package and event requirements; confirmed by the team.
- Photography: available as an add-on service.
- Date conflicts: the team informs if a date is unavailable and suggests alternatives.
- Early booking: recommended for weekends, peak dates and premium setups.
